title: 2008 AMC12A 14
statement: What is the area of the region defined by the inequality \[|3x - 18| + |2y + 7| \le 3?\]

solutions.text:
The region is a rhombus centered at \(\left(6, -\tfrac{7}{2}\right).\) Setting \(2y + 7 = 0\) gives \(|3x - 18| \le 3,\) so \(x \in [5, 7],\) a horizontal diagonal of length \(2.\)

Setting \(3x - 18 = 0\) gives \(|2y + 7| \le 3,\) so \(y \in [-5, -2],\) a vertical diagonal of length \(3.\)

The area of the rhombus is half the product of its diagonals, \[ \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cdot 3 = 3. \]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: The region is a rhombus centered where \(3x - 18 = 0\) and \(2y + 7 = 0\)
Its horizontal diagonal spans \(x \in [5, 7]\) and its vertical diagonal spans \(y \in [-5, -2]\)
